title: Bitcoin Bloom
description: A surreal scene shows an open, weathered hand in the foreground holding a dark perfume bottle tied with a pink ribbon and an orange Bitcoin tag with a lightning bolt. Large pink and yellow peonies surround the hand while three women with elaborate floral headdresses and ornate garments appear on the right, one holding a glowing Bitcoin coin.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a weathered open hand in the foreground holding a dark ribbed perfume bottle with pink ribbon and an orange Bitcoin tag with lightning bolt. The hand is surrounded by large blooming pink and yellow peonies with green leaves. To the right, three elegant women with intricate floral headdresses and ornate patterned garments, one holding a glowing physical Bitcoin coin. Dreamlike colorful background with soft glowing light, mystical and symbolic atmosphere.
